body:
**Defect found while integrating sprint 2 (in accepted work, reported to the person):**

**Symptom:** a Claude-protocol custom CLI pointing at `~/.local/bin/claude` (2.1.291) is refused at the handshake on this machine. `claude` exits with code 1: "You cannot use --strict-mcp-config when an enterprise MCP config is present".

**Cause:** `src/main/agents/adapters/claude.ts` `probeModels` always sets `strictMcpConfig: true` (about line 217). DM-260's Claude handshake reuses that probe, and so does the built-in Claude model listing, which then quietly falls back to the curated list. Chats don't pass the flag, so built-in Claude chats still work.

**Impact:** DM-255 c4 ("A Claude-protocol custom CLI at `~/.local/bin/claude` connects and answers in a chat") can't pass on a machine with an enterprise MCP config.

**Found by:** DM-261 (screenshot `docs/verification/DM-261-custom-cli-refused.png`).
